messages:
IncidentBot: :rotating_light: High error rate detected on /v1/generate (500s). 10m rolling error rate 7.8% (> 3% threshold). Paging rota: @Maya (oncall), @sre-rotation.

Maya (oncall): I'm on it. Seeing elevated latency + OOM-like failures on titan-x nodes serving long-context requests. Root cause unclear yet.

Maya (oncall): Quick question — any running deploys right now?

OpsDeployBot: No active deploys in the last 30m.

Ravi (runtime): I can look at batch queues. Initial glance: continuous-batcher queue depth jumped and a few workers started rejecting new requests due to KV cache growth.

Maya (oncall): Ok. Immediate mitigations suggestion list: 1) tighten per-tenant rate limits 2) lower continuous batching max_tokens and batch_wait 3) disable non-critical reranking route 4) route long-context traffic to fallback smaller model. I'll execute 1-3 now.

Maya (oncall): Applying per-tenant throttle for high-volume tenants. Command: ```rdctl quotas update --tenant whitelisted-1 --rate 50r/m --burst 10``` Executing for top 5 noisy tenants.

OpsDeployBot: quotas service: updated 5 tenants (whitelisted-1, acme-prod, corpus-qa, dev-demos, partner-x).

Ravi (runtime): Pushing continuous-batcher override: lowering max_batch_size from 2048 to 512 and batch_wait from 80ms to 30ms to favor latency over throughput. Patch: ```service config set continuous_batcher.max_batch_size=512 continuous_batcher.batch_wait_ms=30 --apply-now``` Doing a rolling restart on one pool first.

Maya (oncall): Also disabling reranker pipeline (non-critical) to reduce token churn. Endpoint toggle: ```featureflag set reranker_enabled=false --scope=global```

Support: Noted. We have two customers (acme-prod, partner-x) reporting degraded tail latency. We just throttled them — informing account teams.

Jamal (oncall): Joining. What about model fallbacks? Can we route long-context >4096 requests to t-small?

Ravi (runtime): Yes — adding traffic-shape rule in router: ```route if request.context_len > 4096 -> model:t-small fallback:true``` Will canary 5% first.

Maya (oncall): Canary traffic rule applied at 5%. Observing metrics: error rate dropping from 7.8% -> 3.2% over 3 minutes. avg p95 token latency down ~120ms.

IncidentBot: Alert update: error rate now 3.1% (10m rolling).

Maya (oncall): Still seeing a small cluster with frequent KV eviction thrashing. Ravi, can you limit KV cache per-request to 64MB temporarily?

Ravi (runtime): Applying KV cap: ```runtime set kv_cache.max_per_request=64MB --hotpatch``` Done on 3 pools.

Maya (oncall): Handing off to Jamal for overnight monitoring and customer comms. Notes: throttles applied to top noisy tenants, continuous-batcher scaled down (max_batch_size=512, batch_wait=30ms), reranker disabled, canary fallback routing to t-small at 5%, KV per-request cap 64MB. Root cause likely long-context heavy workloads + cache blowup. If error rate stays <4% for 30m we'll move to mitigation unwind.

Jamal (oncall): Acknowledged. I'll watch dashboards and engage SRE if any regression. Quick checklist I'm taking: 
- confirm 15m and 30m error windows
- notify account leads for throttled tenants + support doc snippet
- prepare rollback steps for each mitigation

Jamal (oncall): Notifying account teams for acme-prod and partner-x: "We've applied temporary throttles and routing changes to reduce errors. We'll update when mitigations are relaxed."

Support: Ticket created: INC-2026-894. Linked to both accounts, included mitigation summary.

OpsDeployBot: config-change audit: continuous-batcher override, kv cap, route rule, reranker flag, quotas updated. Change IDs: cfg-5887, cfg-5888, cfg-5889, cfg-5890.

Maya (oncall): Metrics steady for 20m. p95 latency back to normal for majority; error rate 2.7%. We'll keep mitigations until morning.

Jamal (oncall): Handoff complete. Leaving a runbook note in the incident: "If errors spike after unwinding: re-enable reranker=false, reapply batch settings, re-throttle noisy tenants, and escalate to runtime oncall."

sre-rotation: Thanks — great playbook. Can you paste the exact rollback commands into the runbook?

Jamal (oncall): Pasted rollback commands into INC-2026-894 runbook section "mitigation rollback".

Maya (oncall): Marking this thread resolved for paging; keeping incident open for followup postmortem and root-cause analysis.

IncidentBot: Incident ack updated: status=mitigated, pager cleared for oncall.

Jamal (oncall): I'll monitor overnight and file a postmortem draft tomorrow with batch shape telemetry, KV cache traces, and tenant behavior.

Support: Customers informed; CS follow-up scheduled.

Maya (oncall): Thanks team.
